_note: Timers in seconds. Build costs are PLACEHOLDERS. build_time = seconds of construction after placing (starting buildings are already built). max_workers = most workers it can employ at level 1; worker_type = which kind (wages in game_config.json). The player picks Low / Medium / High staffing (share of max_workers, game_config.json) and speed follows the workers actually working: 6 of 8 = 75% speed (plan.md 5.6). Batches/timers scaled for a ~1-2h offline window; per-minute rates match plan.md 5.4.

construction_office.name: Construction Office
construction_office.description: Your headquarters. Everything on the island is built from here.

small_house.name: Small House
small_house.description: A cosy home. People move in over time.

warehouse._comment: Storage: all warehouses together hold the company's goods (one shared stock). capacity = room with all its workers working; when the town is short of people it gets fewer and less room (2 of 4 = half). fixed_workers = no Low/Medium/High choice: it always asks for max_workers (more only by upgrading, Phase 2: level 2 doubles them). Always working, so always paid (plan.md 5.10).
warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Stores your goods. Build more warehouses for more room.

wheat_farm._comment: Extractor: produces on its own until storage is full (900 = 90 min).
wheat_farm.name: Wheat Farm
wheat_farm.description: Grows wheat all by itself until its storage is full.

flour_mill._comment: 8 queued jobs x 6 min = 48 min of work.
flour_mill.name: Flour Mill
flour_mill.description: Grinds wheat into flour, one batch at a time.

bakery._comment: 8 queued jobs x 10 min = 80 min of work.
bakery.name: Bakery
bakery.description: Bakes flour into fresh bread that sells for more.
